grammar_title: 状语从句综合复习(时间/条件 · 让步/原因 · 结果/目的/方式)
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修四 Unit 3 Using language: Review adverbial clauses。三点:时间与条件连词 / 让步与原因连词 / 结果·目的·方式连词。连词由从句逻辑意义决定,干扰项为逻辑错误的连词,使答案唯一;零术语、全填空应用题、句子地道,围绕敦煌与丝绸之路主题。

points.point: 时间与条件状语从句(when/while/as/until/before/after/as soon as · if/unless/as long as/in case)
points.overview: 看从句与主句的逻辑:先后或同时发生用时间连词(when 当…时、while/as 在…期间、until 直到、as soon as 一…就);提出前提或条件用条件连词(if 如果、unless 除非、as long as 只要、in case 以防)。

points.point: 让步与原因状语从句(though/although/even though/while · because/since/as/now that)
points.overview: 前后有“转折让步”关系用让步连词(although/though/even though 虽然、while 尽管/而);前后是“因为—所以”的原因关系用原因连词(because/since/as 因为、now that 既然)。

points.point: 结果·目的·方式状语从句(so…that/such…that · so that/in order that · as if/as though)
points.overview: “如此…以致于”的结果用 so+形容词/副词+that 或 such+(a/an)+名词+that;表“为了”的目的用 so that / in order that;表“仿佛、好像”的方式用 as if / as though。

questions.stem: ____ travellers finally reached Dunhuang, they saw the green oasis ahead of them.
questions.explanation: 句意:旅人到达敦煌时看见绿洲,前后是同时发生的时间关系 → When。其余连词使句意不通。

questions.stem: ____ the guide entered the dark cave, she turned on her torch to show us the murals.
questions.explanation: 句意:导游一进洞就打开手电,“一…就”用 As soon as。其余使句意不通。

questions.stem: ____ we were walking through the grottoes, our guide explained the history of the Silk Road.
questions.explanation: 句意:走过洞窟“期间”导游讲解,表同时进行 → While。

questions.stem: The murals stayed hidden ____ a Taoist priest discovered the sealed Library Cave in 1900.
questions.explanation: 句意:壁画一直藏到道士发现藏经洞为止,表“直到”→ until。

questions.stem: The caves had been carved for centuries ____ the Tang Dynasty reached its golden age.
questions.explanation: 句意:洞窟开凿在唐代鼎盛“之前”已持续数百年,表先后 → before。

questions.stem: ____ the trade routes changed, Dunhuang slowly faded from people's memory.
questions.explanation: 句意:贸易路线改变“之后”敦煌渐被遗忘,表先后时间 → After。

questions.stem: ____ the years passed, Dunhuang grew into a world-class tourist destination.
questions.explanation: 句意:随着岁月流逝敦煌逐渐发展,表“随着”→ As。

questions.stem: ____ night fell over the desert, the temperature around Dunhuang dropped very quickly.
questions.explanation: 句意:夜幕降临“时”气温骤降,表时间 → When。

questions.stem: ____ the museum opens each morning, visitors hurry to see the famous Flying Apsaras.
questions.explanation: 句意:博物馆一开门游客就赶去看飞天,“一…就”→ As soon as。

questions.stem: Keep walking forward ____ you reach the wall covered with thousands of tiny Buddhas.
questions.explanation: 句意:一直往前走直到到达那面墙,表“直到”→ until。

questions.stem: ____ you look up, you can see the colourful paintings on the ceiling of the cave.
questions.explanation: 句意:你若抬头就能看到壁画,前后是条件关系 → If。其余连词使句意矛盾或不通。

questions.stem: ____ you book a ticket in advance, you will not be allowed into the Mogao Grottoes.
questions.explanation: 句意:除非提前订票,否则不准进入,“除非”→ Unless。

questions.stem: You may take photos in the cave ____ you do not use a flash.
questions.explanation: 句意:只要不用闪光灯就可以拍照,表“只要”→ as long as。

questions.stem: Take a bottle of water with you ____ you feel thirsty in the dry desert air.
questions.explanation: 句意:带瓶水以防口渴,表“以防”→ in case。

questions.stem: ____ the weather is good tomorrow, we will climb the Mingsha Mountain near Dunhuang.
questions.explanation: 句意:如果明天天气好就去爬鸣沙山,表条件 → If。

questions.stem: Visitors cannot understand the murals well ____ a guide explains the old stories to them.
questions.explanation: 句意:除非导游讲解,否则游客看不懂壁画,“除非”→ unless。

questions.stem: ____ you keep your voice low, you are welcome to stay and enjoy the wall paintings.
questions.explanation: 句意:只要小声说话就欢迎你留下,表“只要”→ As long as。

questions.stem: The team made careful copies of the scrolls ____ the fragile originals were ever damaged.
questions.explanation: 句意:复制卷轴以防原件受损,表“以防”→ in case。

questions.stem: ____ you visit Dunhuang in summer, remember to bring a hat against the strong sun.
questions.explanation: 句意:如果夏天去敦煌记得带帽子,表条件 → If。

questions.stem: The ancient city would not have grown rich ____ the Silk Road had passed through it.
questions.explanation: 句意:要不是丝绸之路经过,这座城不会富裕,“除非/要不是”→ unless。

questions.stem: ____ Dunhuang was once such a great city, it gradually faded from memory.
questions.explanation: 句意:敦煌虽曾辉煌,却逐渐被遗忘,前后转折 → Although。

questions.stem: ____ the desert journey was dangerous, many traders still crossed it to reach Dunhuang.
questions.explanation: 句意:尽管旅程危险,商人仍穿越,前后让步 → Even though。

questions.stem: The Library Cave is small, ____ it once held thousands of priceless manuscripts.
questions.explanation: 句意:藏经洞虽小,却藏过无数珍贵手稿,转折 → though。

questions.stem: ____ some murals show religious stories, others picture the daily life of ordinary people.
questions.explanation: 句意:有些壁画画宗教故事,而另一些画日常生活,表对比让步 → While。

questions.stem: ____ the paintings are over a thousand years old, their colours are still surprisingly bright.
questions.explanation: 句意:画作虽逾千年,色彩依旧鲜亮,前后转折 → Although。

questions.stem: Visitors keep coming to the grottoes, ____ the tickets are not at all cheap.
questions.explanation: 句意:尽管门票不便宜,游客仍络绎不绝,让步 → even though。

questions.stem: ____ he was only a poor Taoist priest, his discovery changed the study of the Silk Road.
questions.explanation: 句意:他虽只是个穷道士,其发现却改变了丝路研究,转折 → Though。

questions.stem: ____ the north of the city was busy with trade, the southern caves stayed quiet and holy.
questions.explanation: 句意:城北忙于贸易,而城南洞窟静谧神圣,表对比让步 → While。

questions.stem: ____ the trade routes had moved far away, Dunhuang never lost its cultural treasures.
questions.explanation: 句意:贸易路线虽已远去,敦煌仍未失去文化珍宝,转折 → Although。

questions.stem: The artists kept painting the Flying Apsaras, ____ the work took many years to finish.
questions.explanation: 句意:尽管要画很多年,画师们仍坚持创作飞天,让步 → even though。

questions.stem: The Expo chose Dunhuang ____ it had long been a meeting point of East and West.
questions.explanation: 句意:博览会选敦煌是因为它长期是东西方交汇点,表原因 → because。

questions.stem: ____ Dunhuang sits on the old Silk Road, it became a great centre of cultural exchange.
questions.explanation: 句意:因为敦煌位于古丝路上,它成了文化交流中心,表原因 → Since。

questions.stem: ____ the Belt and Road brings life back to the Silk Road, Dunhuang is busy once again.
questions.explanation: 句意:既然“一带一路”让丝路重焕生机,敦煌再度繁忙,表原因 → Now that。

questions.stem: Many scholars study the old scrolls ____ they reveal how different communities once lived.
questions.explanation: 句意:学者研究卷轴是因为它们揭示了过去的生活,表原因 → because。

questions.stem: ____ the murals are very fragile, the staff keep the light inside the caves quite low.
questions.explanation: 句意:因为壁画十分脆弱,工作人员把洞内光线调暗,表原因 → Since。

questions.stem: ____ you have seen the statues, let us move on to the famous Library Cave.
questions.explanation: 句意:既然你已看过雕像,我们就去藏经洞,表原因 → Now that。

questions.stem: Dunhuang grew rich ____ goods from as far away as Europe arrived through its gates.
questions.explanation: 句意:敦煌富裕是因为远至欧洲的货物经此进入,表原因 → because。

questions.stem: ____ very few records survive, the reason the cave was sealed remains a mystery.
questions.explanation: 句意:因为留存的记录极少,封洞之因仍是谜,表原因 → Since。

questions.stem: ____ the city has become a global crossroads, people from many countries come to visit it.
questions.explanation: 句意:既然这座城已成全球汇集地,各国游客纷至,表原因 → Now that。

questions.stem: The guide spoke slowly ____ the long history of the caves was hard to take in all at once.
questions.explanation: 句意:导游讲得慢是因为洞窟的悠久历史一时难以消化,表原因 → because。

questions.stem: The desert sun was ____ strong that we needed both hats and plenty of water.
questions.explanation: “so + 形容词 + that”引导结果状语从句:so strong that → so。such 接名词、very/too 不能引出 that 结果从句。

questions.stem: Dunhuang was ____ a busy crossroads that goods came to it from all over Asia.
questions.explanation: “such + a + 名词 + that”引导结果从句:such a busy crossroads that → such。

questions.stem: The cave was ____ dark that we could hardly see the murals at first.
questions.explanation: “so + 形容词 + that”:so dark that → so。

questions.stem: The Library Cave held ____ amazing treasures that scholars still study them today.
questions.explanation: “such + 名词(复数)+ that”:such amazing treasures that → such。

questions.stem: The colours have lasted ____ long that it is hard to believe their true age.
questions.explanation: “so + 副词 + that”:so long that → so。

questions.stem: It is ____ a famous site that thousands of tourists arrive every single day.
questions.explanation: “such + a + 名词 + that”:such a famous site that → such。

questions.stem: The statues are ____ lifelike that they almost seem ready to speak.
questions.explanation: “so + 形容词 + that”:so lifelike that → so。

questions.stem: Come a little closer ____ you can see the fine details of the painting.
questions.explanation: 句意:走近些“以便”看清细节,表目的 → so that。其余连词使句意不通。

questions.stem: The team copied the scrolls ____ future students could still read them one day.
questions.explanation: 句意:复制卷轴“为了”后人仍能阅读,表目的 → in order that。

questions.stem: The city built rest houses ____ tired traders could sleep safely at night.
questions.explanation: 句意:建驿站“以便”疲惫的商人安睡,表目的 → so that。

questions.stem: The lights are kept low ____ the ancient colours of the murals do not fade away.
questions.explanation: 句意:灯光调暗“为了”古老色彩不褪去,表目的 → in order that。

questions.stem: The Expo was held in Dunhuang ____ countries along the Silk Road could work together.
questions.explanation: 句意:博览会在敦煌举办“以便”沿线国家合作,表目的 → so that。

questions.stem: Our guide spoke loudly ____ everyone standing inside the cave could hear the story.
questions.explanation: 句意:导游大声讲“以便”洞内所有人都能听见,表目的 → so that。

questions.stem: Clear signs are placed everywhere ____ no visitor gets lost among the many caves.
questions.explanation: 句意:到处设清晰指示牌“为了”游客不迷路,表目的 → in order that。

questions.stem: The dancers in the mural move ____ they can really hear the music in the air.
questions.explanation: 句意:壁画中的舞者动作“仿佛”真能听见音乐,表方式 → as if。

questions.stem: The painted figures look ____ they are floating freely in the bright blue sky.
questions.explanation: 句意:画中人物看起来“好像”在蓝天里飘浮,表方式 → as though。

questions.stem: She described the ancient city ____ she had walked through its streets herself.
questions.explanation: 句意:她描述古城“仿佛”亲自走过,表方式 → as if。

questions.stem: The empty Library Cave felt ____ it were still keeping an ancient secret.
questions.explanation: 句意:空荡的藏经洞感觉“好像”仍守着古老的秘密,表方式 → as though。

questions.stem: The guide waved her torch ____ she were painting the dark air with light.
questions.explanation: 句意:导游挥动手电“仿佛”在用光作画,表方式 → as if。

questions.stem: The tired travellers stared at the oasis ____ it were a beautiful dream.
questions.explanation: 句意:疲惫的旅人凝望绿洲“好像”那是个美梦,表方式 → as though。
